description.zh: 深度评测与实操体验 Hiddify Next 全平台代理客户端。覆盖 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 与 Linux 五端一键出海、Sing-box 原生内核驱动、智能协议自适应与小白零配置上手指南。
description.en: Exhaustive review and practical walkthrough of Hiddify Next. Discover its Sing-box native core engine, five-OS multi-device availability, automatic protocol probing, and zero-learning-curve setup for beginners.
